label: Bible Study
prompt: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the _____ shall be the LORD'S.
verse: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
note: The last line of the Old Testament's shortest book — the kingdom belongs to the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given _____ unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verse: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
note: Solomon at the Temple dedication: God gave rest, and not one word of His good promise has failed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his _____, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
verse: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.
note: In old Israel a deal was sealed by handing over a shoe — the nearer kinsman's shoe gave Boaz the right to marry Ruth.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a _____ out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verse: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
note: Balaam, hired to curse Israel, instead sees a star rising out of Jacob — a king far off.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, _____ you like men, be strong.
verse: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
note: 'Quit you like men' is old English for 'conduct yourselves' — act like grown-ups. It doesn't mean give up!
